nice_guideline_used: CG181 / PH46 / NG28 (cardiovascular risk, hypertension NG136, obesity)

medications.duration: Lifelong — review dose in 4 weeks then annually
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 recommends ACE‑I as first‑line antihypertensive

medications.duration: Lifelong — review BP in 2 weeks, then annually
medications.purpose: Add‑on therapy for stage 2 hypertension uncontrolled on ACE‑I
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 advises CCB add‑on when BP remains >140/90 mmHg on ACE‑I/ARB

medications.duration: Lifelong — lipid profile review at 3 months then annually
medications.purpose: Primary prevention of cardiovascular disease in metabolic syndrome (multiple risk factors)
medications.nice_justification: NICE CG181 recommends statin for patients with QRISK ≥10 % or ≥2 CVD risk factors

medications.medication: Orlistat 120 mg three times daily with meals
medications.dose: 120 mg PO TDS with each main meal containing fat
medications.duration: Until BMI <27 kg/m² or patient stops, review every 3 months
medications.purpose: Adjunct to lifestyle for obesity (BMI 30.3 kg/m²) when weight loss goals not met
medications.nice_justification: NICE CG181 advises orlistat for BMI ≥30 kg/m² (or ≥28 kg/m² with comorbidities)

interactions_checked.interaction: No clinically significant interaction; modest increase in serum ACE‑I levels not requiring dose change
interactions_checked.action: No adjustment needed; monitor BP after initiation

interactions_checked.interaction: Low risk of myopathy; risk increases only with high‑dose statins plus CYP3A4 inhibitors, not present here
interactions_checked.action: No adjustment needed; monitor CK if muscle symptoms develop

interactions_checked.interaction: No known pharmacokinetic or pharmacodynamic interaction

assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided – assumed ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m² for ACE‑I and statin dosing; will obtain renal function before any dose changes
Liver function tests not available – required before starting atorvastatin; will order baseline LFTs
QRISK score not calculable from available data – decision to start statin based on presence of multiple risk factors per CG181
Allergy status unknown – will confirm no ACE‑I, CCB, or statin hypersensitivity before prescribing
Pregnancy status not documented – assume not pregnant; advise effective contraception while on ACE‑I and statin
treatment_summary: The patient with metabolic syndrome and uncontrolled stage 2 hypertension is already on low‑dose lisinopril. Add amlodipine 5 mg daily to achieve BP <140/90 mmHg (NICE NG136). Initiate atorvastatin 20 mg nightly for primary CVD prevention (NICE CG181). Offer orlistat as an adjunct for obesity after lifestyle measures, with regular monitoring. Baseline renal, hepatic, and lipid labs are required before finalising doses, and all interactions have been reviewed with no significant concerns.
